text:
maya: Quick heads-up — small router header change (strip X-User-Proto for internal routes). Needs coordinated pin across API, runtime, and console. Target window: Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC. Low risk but affects routing TTL and signer behavior.
alex: Can you paste the exact config diff? I want to validate console's debug header w/ the flag.
rui: Is this going to touch KV eviction TTLs? Our runtime shard heatmaps got weird last week, want to make sure we’re not regressing.
maya: Diff is below. It only toggles a header-stripping middleware and advances router binary to v3.2.1-rc2. Runtime gets a compatibility flag.
--- config/router/middleware.yaml ---
- name: x_user_proto_strip
  enabled: true
  routes: internal/*
+ name: x_user_proto_strip
+ enabled: true
+ routes: internal/*
+ fallback: allow-if-signed

sasha: We should pin API to v1.14.2 for the window and keep console on v0.9.x (no hot swap). Can the deploy bot create the pin?
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: router, version: "3.2.1-rc2", window: "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z/2026-03-26T03:00:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: api, version: "1.14.2", window: "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z/2026-03-26T03:00:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder: quiet-window will start at 01:50 UTC. Autoscaler warmup disabled for the first 10m.
alex: Rollback plan? If router v3.2.1-rc2 starts returning 5xx, do we cut traffic back to v3.2.0? Need the exact quick command.
maya: Yes — fallback to 3.2.0 is the plan. Command is: `deployctl traffic swap --service router --from 3.2.1-rc2 --to 3.2.0 --instant`
rui: On runtime side, the compatibility flag is `--router-header-mode=strip-if-unsigned`. If we see KV latency > 20ms, we rollback runtime first, then router.
sasha: I'll update release notes w/ mention of header strip and signoff checklist. Also adding prompts to the QA runbook for console devtools (verify header present in dev-mode).
maya: Quick checklist before we go live: 1) console pinned, 2) API pinned, 3) runtime feature flag staged to 10% canary, 4) router pinned and warmed, 5) smoke-test chatflow and embeddings path.
alex: I can run smoke tests at 02:05 UTC and report. I'll post results in this thread.
deploy-bot: staged rollout started for runtime (10%): instance-group runtime-canary-1
ops-bot: metric watch created: router/5xx >= 5/min -> notify #eng-oncall and this thread
maya: If all green at 02:10, we bump runtime to 50% for 5m, then 100% at 02:20 — manual proceed checkpoints.
sasha: Release notes draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/releases/1756667777-notes — includes rollback commands and KB for console devs.
alex: Smoke tests: OK for generation and streaming, no header regressions in API logs. Chatflow latency +2ms avg.
rui: Runtime KV latencies stable. No eviction storms.
maya: Proceeding to 50% runtime at 02:12.
deploy-bot: runtime scaled to 50% canary (runtime-canary-1 -> runtime-canary-4).
ops-bot: alert: router/5xx spike detected (6 in last 1m) — paging eng-oncall.
alex: I’m seeing a couple of malformed signed headers from internal test harness — rolling router back to 3.2.0 now.
deploy-bot: traffic swap executed: router 3.2.1-rc2 -> 3.2.0 by maya at 02:18 UTC.
maya: Rolling runtime back to previous flag at 02:20 since routing is back to stable.
deploy-bot: runtime flag removed: --router-header-mode=strip-if-unsigned -> reverted
sasha: Updating release notes: note that we aborted due to header signature mismatch. Will schedule a follow-up patch to add a stricter signer compatibility test.
rui: Filing an infra ticket for KV heatmap monitoring improvements: INFRA-6721.
maya: Thanks all — thread summary: attempted header-strip release, pinned services, canary rollout, observed router 5xx spike due to signed-header mismatch, rolled router back to 3.2.0, reverted runtime flag, will follow up with a patch and extra tests. Closing live window.
sasha: Will circulate a short postmortem and updated QA checklist tomorrow. :handshake:
